data.description_text:
Role Purpose

The Product & Technical Expert (PTE) leads and manages the product and technical tasks of the Agentic AI in Contact Center project across its three components — the virtual AI bot / conversational IVR, the agent-assist, and interaction analytics. The role spans requirements and vendor selection through solution design, integration, AI governance, and delivery oversight, while building lasting in-house capability through knowledge transfer to a nominated internal candidate.

Key Responsibilities
Manage and refine the business and technical requirements across the three components (virtual AI bot / conversational IVR, the agent-assist, and interaction analytics), and maintain the requirements and compliance matrices
Build and maintain the use-cases and intent-prioritization backlog (Tier 1 automated, Tier 2 AI-assisted, Tier 3 human), translating call-driver data into an automation roadmap
Define KPIs and success/acceptance criteria
Support RFP issuance, run the technical evaluation of bidders, lead proofs-of-concept (including Saudi-dialect quality testing), and make sourcing recommendations
Manage the implementation partner technically — scope, statement of work, deliverables, and quality
Manage the conversational and agentic design: open intent capture, dialog flows, prompts, tone/persona, escalation triggers, and warm-handoff behavior
Manage the design of RAG grounding approach, knowledge-base structure, and guardrail configuration
Define the target architecture and external/internal integration design across core banking (T24), CRM (MS Dynamics), Cortex, e-channels,OTP, and the Cisco IVR/ACD and speech-recording stack
Specify APIs, real-time context retrieval, latency targets, and the model-hosting approach
Advise on model selection (LLM/SLM and routing), RAG, hallucination mitigation, confidence thresholds, and prompt/version management
Establish the AI governance and guardrail framework aligned to SAMA and PDPL — human-in-the-loop for sensitive flows, audit trail, data residency, and PII redaction
Work with Compliance, Risk, Legal, and Information Security to secure the necessary approvals
Manage SIT, UAT, and phased go-live; manage risks, issues, and dependencies
Stand up the analytics / AI-ops monitoring and reporting, and run the post-go-live
Coach and up-skill the nominated internal candidate (prospective AI-Ops Lead) and the wider team; produce runbooks and operational handover

Requirements

Experience:10-12 years
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field

We're looking for an experienced bilingual professional who is fluent in Arabic and English to help train AI models. You'll put the newest AI models to work on realistic tasks drawn from your own language expertise, judge what they produce with a native speaker's ear, and tell us exactly where they hold up and where they fall apart.

This is a fast-growing area for our company, focused on teaching AI to communicate naturally across languages and cultures. The models can already produce fluent-looking Arabic. What they can't yet do reliably is tell "correct" from "natural": the right dialect, register, idiom and cultural context. Your language instincts, cultural knowledge and written reasoning become the signal that shapes the next generation of multilingual AI.

What You'll Do

Write challenging, realistic prompts and conversations in Arabic and English, drawn from your own experience (a translation, a customer support exchange, a business email, a lesson plan)
Evaluate AI responses the way you'd review a colleague's work: accuracy, fluency, grammar, tone, register, and whether it followed the request
Compare two AI responses to the same prompt and make the call on which performed better and where each fell short
Critique AI-generated translations, conversations, summaries and written content, and explain your reasoning clearly
Flag concrete failures with evidence, such as mistranslations, overly literal phrasing, wrong dialect or register, grammar errors, cultural missteps, or ignored instructions
Contribute across a wide range of language tasks and subject areas

Projects Span

Translation and localization: Arabic to English, English to Arabic, and adapting content for regional audiences
Conversation and support: customer service, administrative and virtual assistant scenarios
Writing and editing: business, creative and educational content
Education: tutoring, grammar explanations and lesson content
Dialect and culture: Modern Standard Arabic alongside regional dialects

Translators, interpreters, teachers and bilingual professionals with experience across Modern Standard Arabic and regional dialects (Gulf, Iraqi, Levantine) are especially welcome.

Advantages Of Contracting With Us

You'll be able to choose which projects you want to work on and when
You work on your own schedule, on your own computer, from the comfort of your own home
Projects are paid hourly starting at $25–$40+/hr, with bonus rates available on some projects

Qualifications

Native or near-native fluency in Arabic and English
Strong command of grammar, style, tone and register in both languages
Detail-oriented, with the ability to explain your judgments clearly in writing
Experience in translation, interpretation, teaching, editing or bilingual professional work is a plus
A current, in-progress or completed Bachelor's degree is preferred but not required

Note

Payment is made via PayPal. We will never ask for any money from you. PayPal will handle any currency conversions from USD. Only applicants in Saudi Arabia, Iraq, and the United Arab Emirates will be considered for this role. This is an independent contractor position.

Technical direction: Define the technical direction of every engagement: architecture, model and partner choices, and the build, partner or buy decisions behind them. 
Build the organisation: Hire and lead forward deployed engineers and their leads; design pods sized to signed demand, the hiring bar, the career paths and an engineering culture people want to join, with a deliberate pipeline of engineering talent in the region. 
Answer for delivery: Own the technical quality of every deployment from prototype to production, and sign off scope, architecture and technical risk before Echelon commits to a customer. Stay close enough to live systems to review designs, unblock critical issues and lead incident reviews. 
Support the sale: Be the senior technical counterpart in strategic pursuits: architecture, security and data-residency reviews, demos and solution design with customer CIOs and CISOs. Shape how engagements are scoped and priced. 
Set the standards: Set how Echelon builds, secures and operates AI systems, with the security and data baseline every deployment meets, aligned with data-protection and security regulations, and hold delivery partners to it. 
Transfer capability: Make sure every deployment leaves the customer able to run it: documentation, evaluations, monitoring, training and a clean handover. 
Shape the platform: Work with the platform lead to shape Echelon’s platform roadmap and its evolution over time, bringing repeated delivery patterns and customer needs back from the field. 
Shape the ecosystem: Lead the technical relationship with technology partners and model providers across Echelon’s engagements. 

Where We Align

AI and Technology First

Leadership record: You have 6+ years in engineering, including building and leading teams that ship production systems, as a senior leader in an AI company, a forward deployed business, or as a technical founder. 
Builder’s record: You have taken a product or platform from zero to real users at scale, and know the difference between a demo and a system an enterprise depends on. 
AI-native depth: Hands-on with LLMs, agent frameworks, MCP, retrieval and evaluation, with a clear view of how to make AI systems observable, safe and reliable at scale. You still go hands-on when it matters. 
Systems at scale: Command of distributed systems, data engineering, and cloud and on-premise infrastructure under strict data residency and security constraints. 
Enterprise delivery: You have led complex deployments for large enterprises or government, including technical pre-sales, scoping and the commercial trade-offs behind them. 
Executive credibility: Customer technology leaders, partners and investors trust your judgement, and you can explain a trade-off to an engineer and to a board on the same day. 

Strong Advantage

Academic depth: A PhD in AI, Machine Learning or Computer Science. 
Regional experience: Delivery in Saudi Arabia or the GCC, ideally in the public sector or regulated industries, with working knowledge of PDPL, NCA and SDAIA frameworks. 
Arabic & multimodal: Experience building Arabic NLP, speech or multimodal systems. Arabic language is a plus. 
Open-weight models: Fine-tuning, post-training or serving open-weight models on private or on-premise infrastructure. 
Partnerships: Experience leading technical relationships with model providers, cloud providers or technology partners. 

Our Values

Customer first: You measure your work by customer outcomes, and prioritise accordingly. 
Ownership mentality: You own outcomes end to end. When something breaks or stalls, you treat it as yours to fix. 
Clear communicator: You explain complex systems simply, to operators and executives alike, and make the value of your work visible. 
Comfortable with ambiguity: You make progress with incomplete information, partial data and unfamiliar environments, and you enjoy solving problems where there is no structure yet. 
Long-term builder: You invest in Echelon’s long-term success, bringing field insight back into our strategy and operations. 
Builds others: You measure yourself by the engineers you develop and the capability you leave behind with customers. 

The Seat

Location: London, with regular time in Riyadh, or Riyadh
Reports to: The Managing Director
Travel: Regular time on customer sites across the region and with partners abroad. 
Package: A base salary, performance bonus, medical cover, and equity through the employee equity programme. Terms are shared at offer stage. 

How We Work

You start from the problem, not the tool. You meet an unclear brief or a broken environment with energy and a plan.

Curiosity: You learn how the work really happens on site and keep learning as the stack moves. 
Speed: You move from brief to a working system quickly and do not wait for perfect conditions. 
Rigour: You reproduce before you fix, test what you ship and can explain every choice. 
Confidence & humility: You challenge and accept challenge, and change your view on evidence, without ego. 
Autonomy: You decide with incomplete information and own it; from an outcome, you organise the work yourself. 
Resourcefulness: Missing access, partial data, an unfamiliar codebase: you find a way with what is available. 
Situational leadership: You lead when the moment calls for it, and follow when someone else has the better call. 
A force multiplier: Your reviews, patterns and documentation make the whole bench faster. 
AI-native depth: AI tools are part of how you write, review and debug code and how you run the organisation, and you have built something real with an LLM.

data.description_text:
At Mirai, a Scopely Studio, we're passionate about creating engaging gaming experiences that delight millions of players worldwide. We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer, AI platform, who builds products and can see the platform inside them. You will write product features yourself, and you will turn what repeats across products into shared services and libraries the rest of the team builds on. The platform comes out of real product work, one product at a time, not ahead of it.

Our AI Native Engineering team builds software for Scopely game teams and internal departments: tools that use large language models (LLMs) for bug triage, player feedback analysis, market and company research, and contract analytics, alongside direct-to-consumer web stores for Scopely games. Most of these tools repeat one pattern: connect a source system, build a trusted store, put an LLM or governed logic over it, and control who can see what. Today each product builds that pattern its own way, with its own model setup, its own access rules, and its own safety controls.

This is a software engineering role, not an infrastructure role. Our DevOps and SRE engineers own clusters, pipelines, and cloud provisioning. If your recent work is mainly infrastructure with little product code, this is not the right fit.

What You Will Do

Build product features end to end on our internal AI tools, in TypeScript or Python, from design through production
Find what our products build separately and turn it into shared services and libraries: model access and spend, identity and permissions, retrieval, tool servers, and the controls around LLM calls. Move products onto them one at a time, without stopping delivery
Build MCP tool servers that expose company data to agents and chat tools, with the end user's permissions enforced before any data reaches the model
Help introduce relationship-based access control across products, so access rules are defined once and applied to both database queries and vector search
Standardize model access through our LLM gateway, so model choice, cost, and usage are set in one place rather than in each repository
Spread the safety patterns that live in one project each today to every product: prompt-injection handling, kill switches, sandboxed execution of generated code, and locked-down data access
Make the shared pieces easy to adopt: clear APIs, versioning, templates, and documentation another engineer can follow without asking you
Set the standard in code review, including for AI-assisted code, and mentor engineers through review, pairing, and design
Own incidents on what you build, and work with our DevOps engineers on how it is deployed and run

Requirements

What we are looking for 

Six or more years building and running production software, including at least one shared service, library, or internal API that other engineers or teams depended on
Strong TypeScript and Node.js, and strong Python. Our services are split across both
Shipped LLM features to production: retrieval over embeddings, tool calling, structured output, and a way of checking output quality
Designed APIs or libraries other engineers build on, with real attention to versioning, compatibility, safe defaults, and documentation
Built multi-tenant or permission-sensitive systems, and knows where to enforce access so data never reaches a user, or a model, that should not see it. Treats model output and retrieved content as untrusted input
Solid system design: service boundaries, data modeling, failure handling, idempotency, and cost
Production experience on AWS, with infrastructure as code in Terraform or similar, enough to own how your services ship alongside DevOps
Writes tests as part of the work and treats CI checks as gates, not suggestions
Clear written and spoken English, and able to explain technical tradeoffs to product and business stakeholders
Uses AI coding tools and verifies their output. You understand, can prove, and own what you merge

The Stack

Services: Express, FastAPI, Next.js

Riyadh, Saudi Arabia

Full-time
Frontier Context & mandate Echelon is a Saudi-born, sovereign technology company that brings leading global AI technologies to the Kingdom and the world, deploys them through its own forward deployed operations, and productizes Saudi-developed capability. 

Our engineers work on the hardest and most critical problems facing the Kingdom’s largest institutions.

The role: deploying impact

Embedded with customer teams, you own an engagement from the first conversation to its first system in production, delivering value, and then you repeat, with impact that grows over time.

Embed: Work on site with operators and executives, and run each engagement like a venture inside the customer. 
Scope: Turn ambiguous, high-stakes problems into clear technical plans, and build first what creates most value. 
Build: Design and deploy production-grade AI systems powered by LLMs, on architectures built to scale. 
Drive adoption: Put systems in the hands of their users, measure the outcomes, and iterate until the impact is delivered. 
Shape direction: Guide enterprise teams through AI adoption and set the technical direction of each engagement. 

Where we align

AI and technology first

Engineering fundamentals: Strong proficiency in Python or TypeScript, and experience building reliable production systems with modern DevOps practices. 
AI-native: Hands-on with modern LLM tooling such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, Guardrails, MCP or agent frameworks, and a strong understanding of AI system evaluation, debugging and observability. 
Building AI systems: 1+ years building and deploying LLM-powered applications or AI agents in production, including RAG pipelines, tool use and multi-step AI workflows. 

Our values

Customer first: You measure your work by customer outcomes, and prioritise accordingly. 
Ownership mentality: You own outcomes end to end. When something breaks or stalls, you treat it as yours to fix. 
Clear communicator: You explain complex systems simply, to operators and executives alike, and make the value of your work visible. 
Comfortable with ambiguity: You make progress with incomplete information, partial data and unfamiliar environments, and you enjoy solving problems where there is no structure yet. 
Long-term builder: You invest in Echelon’s long-term success, bringing field insight back into our strategy and operations. 

The seat

Location: Riyadh, Saudi Arabia
Package: A base salary with housing, transport and education allowances, medical cover, and equity through the employee equity programme. Terms are shared at offer stage. 

How we work

You start from the problem, not the tool. You meet an unclear brief or a broken environment with energy and a plan.

Curiosity: You learn how the work really happens on site and keep learning as the stack moves. 
Speed: You move from brief to working code quickly and do not wait for perfect conditions. 
Rigour: You reproduce before you fix, test what you ship and can explain every choice. 
Confidence & humility: You challenge and accept challenge, and change your view on evidence, without ego. 
Autonomy: You decide with incomplete information and own it; from an outcome, you organise the work yourself. 
Resourcefulness: Missing access, partial data, an unfamiliar codebase: you find a way with what is available. 
Situational leadership: You lead when the moment calls for it, and follow when someone else has the better call. 
A force multiplier: Your reviews, patterns and documentation make the whole bench faster. 
AI-native depth: AI tools are part of how you write, test and debug code, and you have built something real with an LLM. 
Where you are: From a first role to several years of shipping; fluent in Python, TypeScript or similar.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role for someone who understands both modern Generative AI / LLM technologies and traditional AI/ML engineering, and can turn business requirements into secure, scalable, production-ready systems.

What you'll do:
Lead the architecture, design, and technical implementation of enterprise AI solutions.
Own AI projects technically from experimentation and proof-of-concept through production deployment.
Design solutions using LLMs, Generative AI, RAG, AI agents, NLP, machine learning, and intelligent automation.
Evaluate and select appropriate models, frameworks, vector databases, orchestration tools, and AI platforms.
Design scalable APIs and backend services for integrating AI capabilities into web, mobile, and enterprise systems.
Establish best practices around prompt engineering, retrieval, model evaluation, observability, security, and cost optimization.
Work closely with Data Scientists, AI Engineers, Backend Engineers, DevOps teams, Product Managers, and business stakeholders.
Lead technical discussions with clients and translate complex business problems into practical AI architectures.
Review code and architecture and mentor AI and software engineers.
Ensure AI solutions meet enterprise requirements for security, privacy, performance, scalability, and reliability.
Stay current with developments across the rapidly evolving AI ecosystem and determine which technologies are genuinely suitable for production use.

What we're looking for:
7+ years of software engineering / AI experience, including strong recent experience building production AI solutions.
Strong hands-on development skills, preferably in Python and/or modern backend technologies.
Deep understanding of LLMs and Generative AI architectures.
Hands-on experience with areas such as:
Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
Vector databases and embeddings
AI agents and tool/function calling
Prompt engineering and evaluation
LLM orchestration frameworks
NLP and machine learning
Model APIs and open-source models
Strong understanding of APIs, microservices, distributed architectures, and cloud-native applications.
Experience deploying AI workloads on cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
Understanding of MLOps / LLMOps, CI/CD, monitoring, model evaluation, and production observability.
Strong understanding of AI security, data privacy, access control, and responsible AI considerations.
Ability to lead technical teams while remaining highly hands-on.
Strong communication skills and confidence working directly with enterprise clients and senior stakeholders.

Preferred experience:
Experience delivering AI solutions within digital banking, fintech, financial services, government, or other large enterprise environments is highly valued.
Experience building production solutions involving enterprise knowledge assistants, intelligent search, conversational AI, document intelligence, personalization, recommendation systems, or AI-powered workflows would be a strong advantage.

You will work at the intersection of AI operations, customer care, product development, and technical implementation in a fully remote, international environment. Your work will help deliver faster, more reliable, and more human customer interactions while ensuring seamless escalation to human support when needed. By analyzing performance data, refining workflows, and testing emerging technologies, you will directly influence how AI transforms customer service. Nabeh is looking for an AI Project Manager, Senior to lead the end-to-end delivery of AI, computer vision, Generative AI (GenAI), and intelligent-platform projects. The role is responsible for translating contractual commitments into secure, technically feasible, and measurable client outcomes while managing project scope, schedules, budgets, quality, risks, and formal acceptance. The Senior AI Project Manager will serve as the primary coordination point between clients, AI and engineering teams, infrastructure, vendors, and internal stakeholders to ensure successful project delivery and alignment with business objectives.
Key Responsibilities

Lead project initiation and handover from Sales, reviewing contracts, statements of work (SOWs), purchase orders (POs), deliverables, commercial milestones, dependencies, and acceptance criteria.
Develop and maintain integrated project management plans, detailed schedules, milestones, forecasts, and approved project baselines, ensuring changes are documented and formally approved.
Manage project kickoffs, stakeholder communication, risk and issue tracking, change requests, status reporting, steering committees, and escalation processes.
Maintain accurate project documentation, contracts, approvals, deliverables, and correspondence, ensuring records are organized and audit-ready.
Coordinate the end-to-end AI delivery lifecycle, including discovery, requirements gathering, solution design, data preparation, model development or configuration, integration, deployment, user acceptance testing (UAT), go-live, and hyper care.
Track AI model performance requirements and success measures, including precision, recall, false positives, inference latency, operational monitoring, and retraining requirements, where applicable.
Monitor readiness of datasets, development environments, GPUs, edge devices, camera streams, APIs, cloud or on-premises infrastructure, cybersecurity reviews, licenses, and third-party integrations.
Coordinate technical validation, security and privacy approvals, client UAT, production readiness, user training, handover, and service transition, ensuring the required evidence and technical sign-offs are obtained.
Coordinate AI engineers, technical leads, DevOps, infrastructure, business analysts, QA, UI/UX, support, field teams, and subcontractors to align responsibilities, priorities, dependencies, and delivery commitments.
Monitor project progress, identify blockers and resource constraints, and coordinate recovery plans and escalations through PMO and functional leadership.
Coordinate site readiness, permits, logistics, safety requirements, and vendor mobilization for field and edge AI deployments.
Track project budgets, resource utilization, timesheets, vendor purchase orders, cost-to-complete, financial milestones, invoicing requirements, and potential margin exposure.
Coordinate signed acceptance documents, completion certificates (CoCs), and supporting evidence required for timely invoicing and payment.
Manage subcontractor deliverables, schedules, dependencies, and handovers, coordinating contractual and commercial changes with Sales, Finance, Procurement, and Legal.
Serve as the primary day-to-day client contact for project delivery, communicating progress, issues, corrective actions, and decisions clearly and proactively in English and Arabic as required.
Coordinate quality assurance activities, defect prioritization, UAT plans, issue resolution, user training, operational documentation, support service-level agreements (SLAs), and formal client acceptance.
Lead project closure activities, including documentation handover, lessons learned, financial reconciliation, and transition to support or managed services.
Prepare regular project status reports highlighting milestones, risks, budget status, delivery progress, outstanding actions, and issues requiring management attention.

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, AI Engineering, or a related field.
7+ years of project delivery experience, including at least 2 years managing AI, analytics, computer vision, software/platform, or complex integration projects.
Strong knowledge of project management practices aligned with PMI principles, including scope, schedule, risk, stakeholder, procurement, cost, quality, and change control.

Experience working with enterprise clients, vendors, statements of work (SOWs), purchase orders (POs), project budgets, invoicing milestones, and formal acceptance processes.

Strong leadership, organizational, stakeholder management, problem-solving, and communication skills.
Ability to manage multiple priorities, project risks, deadlines, and cross-functional dependencies effectively.
Ability to maintain accurate project documentation and handle confidential business and client information professionally.

data.description_text:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI Product Concept Designer & Interior Stylist – Home Décor (Part-/Full-time) based in Saudi Arabia.

In this fully remote role, you will combine creative vision, interior design expertise, and advanced AI image-generation skills to develop distinctive, commercially promising home décor products. You will transform emerging design trends and customer preferences into original product concepts and compelling visual experiences. A key part of your work will involve creating photorealistic interior scenes that showcase products with accurate materials, textures, colors, and proportions. You will collaborate with designers to refine concepts and prepare product visuals for e-commerce launches. By balancing aesthetics with commercial potential, you will help shape an attractive product portfolio for a premium home décor brand serving online customers. This long-term freelance opportunity offers the flexibility to work part-time or full-time while contributing directly to product innovation and digital merchandising. It is ideal for a visually driven creative professional who understands how to turn inspiring design ideas into products customers want to buy.

Accountabilities

Product concept development: Research interior design trends, competitor offerings, and customer preferences to identify new home décor opportunities and develop original, commercially viable product concepts.
AI-powered concept visualization: Use advanced generative AI tools to explore, visualize, and refine new physical product ideas, translating creative concepts into compelling visual representations.
Interior styling and scene creation: Place existing and proposed products into realistic, aesthetically cohesive AI-generated interiors that reflect different design styles, including Japandi, organic modern, and coastal interiors.
Photorealistic product imagery: Produce high-quality lifestyle and product visuals for e-commerce websites, ensuring generated images accurately represent the original products' shapes, proportions, materials, colors, and textures.
Visual quality and consistency: Maintain high standards of realism, composition, lighting, and styling across all creative outputs, ensuring that product details remain faithful to the intended designs.
Trend research and opportunity identification: Monitor emerging interior styles, materials, product categories, and customer preferences to uncover opportunities for new product development and commercial growth.
Cross-functional collaboration: Work closely with designers and relevant team members to refine concepts, incorporate feedback, and prepare product designs and visual assets for launch.
Commercial evaluation: Assess the market appeal and potential sales value of proposed products, balancing aesthetic originality with customer demand and commercial objectives.
E-commerce content development: Create visually engaging product and lifestyle imagery that strengthens online merchandising, communicates product value, and supports customer purchasing decisions.
Creative workflow management: Organize multiple projects, manage deadlines, maintain clear communication, and deliver consistent, high-quality outputs in a fully remote working environment.
Product feasibility awareness: Consider practical manufacturing requirements, material limitations, production constraints, and shipping considerations when developing physical product concepts.

Requirements

Visual design and aesthetic expertise: Excellent visual taste and a strong understanding of interior design, styling, color theory, materials, textures, proportions, and composition.
Advanced AI image-generation skills: Demonstrated proficiency with generative AI tools such as Nano Banana, Flux, Adobe Firefly, Midjourney, or comparable platforms.
Photorealistic image creation: Proven ability to generate convincing interior scenes and product imagery while preserving accurate product characteristics, including shape, material, color, texture, and proportions.
Creative concept development: Strong imagination and the ability to translate market insights, design inspiration, and customer preferences into original, visually appealing, and commercially promising physical products.
Relevant portfolio: A portfolio demonstrating high-quality interior visuals, AI-generated imagery, product concepts, home décor projects, or other closely related creative work.
Project management and organization: Strong organizational skills, reliability, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple creative assignments while meeting deadlines.
English proficiency: Fluent English communication skills for collaborating with the team, discussing concepts, understanding feedback, and documenting creative decisions.
Commercial awareness: An understanding of how visual design, product differentiation, and customer preferences influence purchasing decisions in e-commerce.

Strongly Preferred

Professional experience in home décor, interior styling, furniture, or lifestyle products.
Experience developing concepts for physical products from initial inspiration through visual refinement.
Familiarity with US interior design trends, home décor preferences, and target customer expectations.
Experience producing product photography alternatives, lifestyle visuals, or marketing imagery for e-commerce websites.
Knowledge of wood, natural finishes, and other materials commonly used in premium home décor.

Nice To Have

Experience collaborating with manufacturers, product designers, or suppliers.
Understanding of product feasibility, manufacturing processes, production constraints, and shipping considerations.
Experience using Pinterest, Instagram, or similar platforms to research interior design inspiration, consumer trends, and emerging product opportunities.
Familiarity with iterative creative workflows that combine AI-generated concepts with product development and commercial evaluation.

Important role clarification: This position focuses on AI-assisted product concept development, interior styling, and photorealistic visual creation. It is not a traditional CAD design or UX/UI design role. The ideal candidate combines outstanding visual judgment with the ability to create attractive, realistic, and commercially viable home décor concepts using generative AI.

Competitive compensation: US$25–$45 per hour, depending on experience, skills, and portfolio quality.
Flexible engagement: Choose between part-time and full-time collaboration, with an expected workload of approximately 25 hours per week.
100% remote work: Work remotely from Anywhere.

Freelance flexibility: Independent contractor engagement, offering flexibility in organizing your work and managing creative projects.
Creative ownership: Contribute directly to product concepts, interior styling, and visual assets that support commercial launches.
AI-driven innovation: Work with modern generative AI tools to explore new creative workflows and develop innovative product imagery.
Cross-functional collaboration: Partner with designers and other team members to refine concepts and bring new home décor products to market.
Portfolio development: Build experience creating AI-powered product concepts and high-quality lifestyle visuals for a premium direct-to-consumer e-commerce business.

Your portfolio featuring relevant interior visuals, product concepts, AI-generated images, or home décor projects.

Our innovative products, services, and solutions empower both financial institutions and individuals to optimize their operations and enhance client satisfaction 

. JOB SUMMARY
The Cybersecurity, Risk and Resilience Manager at DirectFN is responsible for managing and executing the organization's cybersecurity governance, enterprise risk management, and business continuity programs. This role ensures that DirectFN adheres to relevant cybersecurity frameworks, regulatory standards, and risk management policies — protecting the integrity, availability, and confidentiality of DirectFN's systems, financial data platforms, and client-facing services. The Manager works closely with IT, technology, legal, and compliance teams, and reports directly to the COO, overseeing a cybersecurity specialist and contributing to the operational resilience of a leading fintech company in the Saudi capital markets ecosystem.
II. Key Responsibilities:
1. Cybersecurity Governance
• Collaborate with IT and technology teams to ensure alignment with cybersecurity frameworks including ISO 27001, NIST, and SAMA Cybersecurity Framework (CSF).
• Oversee cybersecurity policy development, maintenance, and enforcement across the organization.
• Conduct and coordinate risk assessments, vulnerability management activities, and incident response planning.
• Engage, manage, and monitor third-party vendors for cybersecurity assessments and timely remediation of identified risks.
• Monitor third-party vendor compliance with DirectFN's cybersecurity standards and contractual security obligations.
2. Enterprise Risk Management
• Operate the end-to-end enterprise risk program — identifying, assessing (likelihood and impact), treating, and monitoring risks across all business functions.
• Maintain a living risk register, applying consistent and practical scoring methodologies aligned with organizational risk appetite and tolerances.
• Conduct quarterly risk reviews with relevant business units and provide updated risk reporting to senior leadership.
• Map identified risks to controls drawn from ISO 27001 or equivalent control frameworks to ensure a robust control environment.
• Coordinate internal audits, manage corrective action plans, and prepare for external audits including ISO 27001 and SOC 2.
• Develop and maintain Key Risk Indicators (KRIs) and executive risk dashboards for leadership reporting.
• Liaise on cyber insurance underwriting data requirements and support the inclusion of risk clauses in customer and supplier contracts.
3. Business Continuity & Operational Resilience
• Lead the development, maintenance, and periodic testing of Business Continuity Plans (BCP) across DirectFN's critical business functions.
• Conduct Business Impact Assessments (BIA) and risk analyses to identify critical dependencies, recovery time objectives, and resilience gaps.
• Coordinate cross-functional continuity exercises and drills to validate the effectiveness of continuity strategies.
• Ensure DirectFN's operational resilience practices comply with relevant regulatory mandates, including SAMA and NCA requirements.
4. Compliance & Regulatory Management
• Maintain current knowledge of applicable regulatory frameworks including SAMA, NCA, GDPR, and ISO 27001, and ensure DirectFN's practices remain compliant.
• Support internal and external compliance reviews, audits, and regulatory submissions related to cybersecurity and risk.
• Provide guidance to business units on regulatory obligations and the implementation of required controls.
5. Incident & Breach Management
• Manage the cybersecurity incident response process — from detection and containment through investigation, remediation, and post-incident review.
• Maintain incident response plans, playbooks, and communication protocols for various breach and disruption scenarios.
• Coordinate with legal, communications, and senior leadership in the event of a material cybersecurity incident or data breach.
6. Team Oversight & Stakeholder Engagement
• Provide day-to-day direction and oversight to the Cybersecurity Specialist, ensuring effective execution of security operations and monitoring activities.
• Engage cross-functionally with IT, engineering, product, legal, and operations teams to embed security and risk awareness across the organization.
• Prepare and present cybersecurity and risk management reports to the COO and relevant leadership stakeholders.
III. Qualifications & Requirements:
○ Education: Bachelor's degree in IT Security, Information Systems, Finance, Law, or a related field; Master's degree preferred.
○ Experience: Minimum 7 years of experience in cybersecurity governance, IT risk management, or compliance within financial services or fintech.
○ Strong understanding of regulatory frameworks including SAMA CSF, NCA ECC, ISO 27001, NIST, and GDPR.
○ Proven experience managing enterprise risk programs, conducting risk assessments, and maintaining risk registers.
○ Hands-on experience with business continuity planning, BIA, and operational resilience frameworks.
○ Excellent analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
○ Fluent in English (spoken and written); Arabic is an advantage.
IV. Prefer to Have:
○ Professional certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CRCM, CCEP, ISO 27001 Lead Implementer/Auditor, or ISO 22301.
○ Experience working within Saudi Arabia's regulatory environment, particularly with SAMA and NCA cybersecurity requirements.
○ Familiarity with SOC 2 audit preparation and cyber insurance underwriting processes.
V. Core Skills:
○ Cybersecurity Governance: Deep knowledge of cybersecurity frameworks, policy development, and risk-based security management.
○ Risk Management: Structured, practical approach to enterprise risk identification, assessment, and mitigation.
○ Regulatory Awareness: Current and comprehensive understanding of cybersecurity and operational compliance obligations in the KSA and GCC.
○ Incident Management: Composed and methodical in managing security incidents, breaches, and business disruptions.
○ Stakeholder Communication: Able to translate technical risk concepts into clear, actionable insights for non-technical leadership.
○ Ethical Judgment: Maintains high standards of integrity and confidentiality in all risk and security activities.
VI. Key Result Areas (KRAs):
○ Regulatory Compliance: DirectFN's cybersecurity and risk practices consistently meeting SAMA, NCA, and relevant international standards.
○ Risk Posture: A well-maintained, up-to-date risk register with active treatment plans and clear ownership across the organization.

Dell Technologies is committed to empowering our customers with innovative products and services that enhance their performance and productivity. The Services Solutions Architecture team plays a pivotal role in delivering technical solutions that consistently meet client needs and expectations. As trusted consultants, we partner closely with our clients to understand their objectives and provide infrastructure solutions designed for scalability, efficiency, and future growth.

We invite you to join our Services Solutions Architecture team as a Principal Engineer - AI & HPC Solutions Architect, where you will have the opportunity to excel professionally and make a significant contribution to the advancement of high-performance computing and AI infrastructure.

What you'll achieve: 

As a member of the services delivery team, you will collaborate with Dell consultants, engineering teams, and client stakeholders to design and implement sophisticated AI and HPC cluster architectures. You will design, deploy, optimize, and support large-scale AI infrastructure environments, ensuring technical excellence and customer satisfaction throughout each phase of the engagement.

Responsibilities

You will:
Design and architect scalable, high-performance compute infrastructures for AI and HPC clusters. Lead the deployment and integration of AI infrastructure solutions utilizing NVIDIA, AMD, and Intel technologies.
Deploy and manage orchestration tools such as NVIDIA Base Command Manager, Slurm, Kubernetes, and related cluster management platforms. Execute benchmarking, validation, and performance optimization activities utilizing tools such as NCCL, HPL, MLPerf, IO500, and related technologies.
Provide expert consulting on AI and HPC infrastructure strategy, planning, implementation, and operational readiness. Collaborate with clients to assess technical requirements and deliver customized infrastructure solutions.
Troubleshoot and resolve complex performance bottlenecks across compute, storage, and network layers. Collaborate with clients to assess technical requirements and deliver customized infrastructure solutions.
Develop comprehensive documentation including architecture diagrams, deployment guides, technical designs, and operational procedures. Act as a trusted technical advisor throughout the customer engagement lifecycle.

Qualifications

Essential Requirements 
Proven success in designing and deploying large-scale HPC and AI clusters utilizing NVIDIA, AMD, and Intel technologies.
Strong experience with Linux systems administration, troubleshooting, and automation. Extensive hands-on experience with NVIDIA Base Command Manager, Slurm, Kubernetes, or equivalent orchestration platforms.
Experience with high-performance networking technologies including InfiniBand and RoCE. Experience performing system benchmarking, performance validation, and optimization activities.
Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects independently and deliver results within dynamic environments. Strong customer-facing communication and consulting skills.
Desirable Requirements 
Experience with NVIDIA DGX and DGX SuperPOD platforms. Familiarity with AI/ML and Generative AI infrastructure environments. Knowledge of containerized AI platforms and software stacks.
Experience with Python, Ansible, Terraform, or similar automation technologies. Knowledge of data center operations, networking, storage architectures, and cloud integration methods. Experience supporting GPU clusters comprising thousands of accelerators.

Position Summary
This is a fully remote, hourly contractor role supporting AI data and language projects on a project-based, flexible hour basis. Project scopes vary and may include:
Data annotation: labeling, classifying, and structuring documents, tables, and other content to support AI training datasets.
LLM evaluation: reviewing AI-generated responses for accuracy, reasoning quality, coherence, and cultural/linguistic appropriateness.
Content generation: writing high-quality prompts and model responses to guide AI learning across diverse topics.
Localization QA: ensuring terminology, tone, cultural nuance, and locale-specific details (units, references, names, dates) are consistently accurate across outputs.

You will apply senior-level Arabic localization and translation judgment alongside minimum C1 English proficiency to ensure terminology, tone, and cultural nuance are consistently accurate across use cases.
Profile Requirements
Bachelor's degree or higher in Translation, Linguistics, Localization, Communications, or a related field.
Native or near-native Arabic proficiency with strong writing and editing skills across Modern Standard Arabic and at least one dialect.
Minimum C1 English proficiency (reading/writing) for interpreting prompts, source materials, and evaluation guidelines.
Excellent editorial judgment in register, tone, punctuation, inclusivity, and cultural nuance, with extreme attention to detail.
Ability to identify meaning drift, ambiguity, locale inconsistencies, and subtle errors, and to explain corrections clearly in writing.
Ability to rigorously fact-check localized content (units, references, names, dates) using reliable sources and consistent reasoning.
Ability to identify reasoning gaps, methodological errors, and unclear explanations even when language is fluent.
Reliable, self-directed, and able to deliver consistent quality with clear communication and responsiveness across time zones.

Preferred Experience
Professional localization or translation experience.
Familiarity with MQM/LQA concepts (severity, category, and root-cause thinking) for consistent quality decisions.
Proficiency with CAT tools and QA workflows (translation memory, termbases, automated checks).
Previous experience with AI data training, annotation, or evaluation.

Job Description:

The organization is seeking a hands-on Senior Software Engineer to lead the development, integration, and ongoing enhancement of enterprise software and AI-powered applications across Front, Middle, and Back Office functions.
This position represents a foundational hire in building the organization’s internal software engineering capability, with the objective of progressively transitioning from vendor-led development to internally owned and delivered digital products.
The successful candidate will initially work closely with external technology partners to review, inherit, and enhance existing solutions while independently developing new applications. The role combines strong software engineering expertise with cloud-native development (Google Cloud), DevOps practices, and exposure to AI technologies.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Software & AI Product Engineering:

• Design, develop, test, and maintain enterprise applications, digital products, APIs, and backend services.

• Develop and integrate AI-powered capabilities, including LLM applications, AI agents, and intelligent automation.
• Translate business requirements into scalable, secure, production-ready solutions.
• Support digital product development across trading, risk management, operations, finance, and corporate functions.

2. Vendor Transition & Technical Ownership:

• Review, assess, and take ownership of source code and applications developed by external vendors.
• Lead technical knowledge transfer, code handovers, and transition of vendor-developed solutions to internal ownership.
• Evaluate code quality, architecture, security, maintainability, and technical documentation.
• Independently troubleshoot, enhance, and extend inherited applications.
• Establish reusable components, development standards, and engineering practices to reduce long-term reliance on external vendors.

3. Cloud Engineering & DevOps:

• Develop, deploy, and maintain applications on Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
• Implement and manage CI/CD pipelines, version control, automated testing, and release processes.
• Manage application deployments across development, testing, and production environments.
• Implement application monitoring, logging, troubleshooting, and performance optimization.
• Collaborate with the existing GCP administrator on cloud infrastructure, security, access management, and deployment environments.

4. Internal Engineering Capability Development:

• Help establish the internal software development practices, coding standards, documentation, and technical architecture.
• Contribute to technology selection, engineering frameworks, and reusable development accelerators.
• Support the evolution of internal software engineering capabilities, including onboarding and mentoring future developers.
• Work closely with AI engineers, data scientists, product owners, business teams, and third-party vendors to deliver enterprise-grade solutions.

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
• 10+ years of hands-on software development experience, including experience delivering production applications.
• Strong proficiency in Python and backend development frameworks such as FastAPI or Django.
• Experience in frontend development using React, TypeScript, JavaScript, or equivalent technologies.
• Strong understanding of software architecture, REST APIs, databases (SQL/NoSQL), application integration, and security.
• Hands-on experience with GCP services, particularly Cloud Run, Cloud Build, Cloud Storage, and related application development services.
• Experience with Git, Docker, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and application deployment.
• Demonstrated ability to independently design, develop, troubleshoot, and maintain production-grade applications.

data.description_text:
LAKEORA is a Riyadh-based data and AI advisory firm and a pure-play Databricks partner. We build the governed data platforms that Saudi enterprises run their decisions on, going deep on one platform rather than wide across many, with governance designed in from the start. We are early-stage, flat, and deliberately small. You work directly with customers, own the architecture you design, and see it reach production. We like engineers who are direct, curious, and would rather get something right than get it agreed.

What are we looking for?

We’re looking for a Data and AI Governance Specialist who supports governance end to end: framework design, data quality, AI risk, and national index readiness (NDI/NAII) that turns compliance into a client deliverable, not a checkbox.

At LAKEORA, this role is client-facing by design. You’ll work directly with client stakeholders, support data and AI governance delivery, and help translate findings into recommendations that are tangible for both technical and business audiences. Lean team, high visibility, real impact.

Key Responsibilities

Data Governance

Support clients in designing and documenting data governance frameworks: ownership models, stewardship roles, policies, and standards
Support data quality initiatives: profiling, defining quality rules, monitoring, and remediation tracking
Support data cataloging, metadata management, and lineage documentation across client environments
Help translate client business requirements into governance scope, deliverables, and effort estimates

AI Governance

Support clients in designing AI governance frameworks: model inventory, risk-tiering, approval workflows, and documentation standards
Help assess client AI systems against responsible AI principles: explainability, auditability, bias, and risk controls
Map client data and AI practices against global frameworks to benchmark maturity

National Index Readiness (NDI / NAII)

Run client readiness assessments against the National Data Index (NDI) and National AI Index (NAII) scoring criteria, identifying gaps between current practice and index requirements
Compile and organize the evidence, documentation, and artifacts clients need to demonstrate compliance for index submissions
Build remediation roadmaps that close index gaps in priority order, sequenced against client timelines and resourcing
Track client progress against NDI/NAII benchmarks across engagement milestones and report status to stakeholders
Stay current on updates to NDI/NAII methodology and criteria, and translate changes into updated client guidance

Client Delivery

Participate in discovery sessions with prospective and existing clients, documenting findings and shaping governance approaches
Coordinate with client enterprise architecture and IT teams to ensure governance work aligns with their broader data and AI strategy
Build working relationships with client business stakeholders and communicate findings in business-impact terms
Support the establishment and operation of client data and AI governance offices

Qualifications

Required:

Bachelor’s degree in IT, Data Management, or a related field
3+ years of experience in data governance and/or AI governance
Strong awareness of local data protection, data management, and AI regulatory frameworks in the Kingdom, including national data and AI indexes such as NDI and NAII
Solid understanding of data standards, policies, procedures, and data quality frameworks
Strong communication skills with the ability to engage both technical and business stakeholders confidently
Fluency in Arabic and English

Preferred:

Direct experience supporting a National Data Index (NDI) or National AI Index (NAII) readiness or submission process
DAMA certification
Familiarity with AI governance/risk frameworks or platforms
Consulting or client-facing delivery experience
Exposure to data governance tooling 
Saudi National

If this sounds like the kind of work you want to do, we would like to hear from you. LAKEORA is an equal opportunity employer and assesses every application on merit.

Responsibilities
About the team:
The Cybersecurity team owns security for all services offered by Volcano Engine & BytePlus which is a cloud service provider owned by ByteDance, including IaaS, PaaS and SaaS. Join our forward-thinking security team dedicated to securing our cloud infrastructure with cutting-edge technologies and best practices. You will have the opportunity to design and implement robust security solutions for our cloud environments, ensuring the protection of sensitive data and the resilience of our systems.

The Director of Information Security is responsible for the overall cybersecurity posture of the organization and for ensuring compliance with applicable cybersecurity laws, regulations, and regulatory frameworks, including the National Cybersecurity Authority (NCA) Essential Cybersecurity Controls (ECC) within the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia (KSA).

This role will provide independent executive leadership and oversight across cybersecurity governance, risk management, and security operations. The role requires a pragmatic, business-oriented leader with strong expertise in cybersecurity, cloud security, and modern technology environments, capable of ensuring that cybersecurity risks are identified, managed, and reported in alignment with the organization's risk appetite and regulatory expectations.

You’ll collaborate closely with senior executives. This role offers the opportunity to shape strategic outcomes, reduce risk exposure, and drive secure innovation across complex, interconnected ecosystems.

Responsibilities:
Cybersecurity Governance & Leadership:
- Establish and maintain enterprise-wide cybersecurity governance in line with SAMA CSF and NCA ECC requirements.
- Ensure clear ownership, accountability, and segregation of duties across cybersecurity functions.
- Advise executive management on cybersecurity risks, threats, and control effectiveness.
- Ensure cybersecurity considerations are embedded into corporate governance and enterprise risk management.

Cybersecurity Risk Management & Compliance:
- Own and oversee the cybersecurity risk management framework.
- Ensure continuous compliance with applicable regulations and industry good practices.
- Ensure timely remediation of audit findings and regulatory observations.
- Act as the primary point of accountability for cybersecurity matters with regulators.

Security Operations & Technology Oversight:
- Oversee cybersecurity operations including monitoring, detection, vulnerability management, IAM, and incident response.
- Ensure effective prevention, detection, response, and recovery capabilities.
- Govern the selection and operation of cybersecurity technologies.
- Ensure security by design across infrastructure, applications, cloud, and data platforms.

Incident Management & Cyber Resilience:
- Ensure effective incident response and cyber crisis management.
- Lead executive coordination during material cybersecurity incidents.
- Ensure alignment with business continuity and disaster recovery.
- Oversee post-incident reviews.

Third-Party & Outsourcing Cybersecurity:
- Ensure third-party cybersecurity risks are identified and managed.
- Ensure compliance of vendors with regulatory and contractual obligations.
- Oversee outsourced and managed security services.

People, Culture & Capability:
- Establish and maintain a compliant cybersecurity operating model.
- Develop national cybersecurity talent in alignment with Saudization.
- Promote cybersecurity awareness and culture.
- Ensure adequate resourcing and training.

About The Role

We are seeking a Member of Technical Staff to join our Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) team. In this customer-facing role, you will work directly with strategic partners and customers as part of the FDE team to enable, optimize, and deploy state-of-the-art GenAI inference workloads on AMD data center CPUs and GPUs (Instinct™ family). You will bridge the gap between cutting-edge AI models and AMD hardware, driving competitive performance across the full inference stack.

Responsibilities

Partner with customers as part of the FDE team to enable and optimize large language models (LLMs) and multimodal models on AMD Instinct GPUs, meeting committed performance and accuracy targets.
Optimize GenAI inference pipelines on vLLM and SGLang, including PD disaggregation, expert parallelism (EP/wide-EP), tensor/data parallelism, speculative decoding, and KV cache management.
Develop and tune low-level GPU kernels (Triton, HIP, composable kernels) for attention, MoE, GEMM, quantization, and normalization operations.
Profile end-to-end workloads, identify bottlenecks across GPU/CPU boundaries, and deliver measurable throughput and latency improvements versus competitive targets.
Enable advanced data types and techniques (FP8, MXFP4, sparse attention) with a focus on both performance and numerical accuracy.
Debug complex runtime, stability, and accuracy issues in production environments; partner with core engineering teams to identify root causes and contribute fixes.
Contribute optimizations back to open-source frameworks (vLLM, SGLang, ATOM, AITER) and internal libraries; document best practices and deliver production-ready artifacts to customers.
Leverage AI-assisted coding tools and agentic workflows to accelerate development, debugging, optimization, and code review across the inference stack.


What You'll Bring

BS, MS, or PhD in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, along with 8+ years of relevant experience.
Solid expertise in GPU architecture and performance optimization, including hands-on experience with AMD ROCm (or CUDA) and GPU kernel development.
Strong proficiency in Python and C++, with experience developing and optimizing kernels using Triton, HIP, or CUDA.
Experience with AI-assisted coding and agentic development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude, Cursor, or equivalent) to enhance productivity in kernel development, large-scale codebase navigation, debugging, and framework integration.
Experience working with LLM inference frameworks (vLLM, SGLang, or equivalent) and serving optimization techniques.
Solid understanding of transformer and MoE architectures, quantization, and distributed inference strategies (TP, DP, EP, and related parallelism techniques).
Proficiency with profiling and debugging tools (e.g., rocProfiler, ROCdebug-agent).


Nice to Have

Experience optimizing frontier models (DeepSeek, Qwen, Kimi, MiniMax, GLM, etc.) in production environments.
Track record of contributing to open-source AI inference frameworks.
Experience integrating AI-driven automation into engineering workflows and developer tooling.
Strong customer-facing communication skills and the ability to manage technical deliverables against committed timelines.
